intro.title: Design Notification System
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple notification system that displays messages to users, such as alerts or updates. You will learn how to manage dynamic content in Vue by using reactive state to store and update notifications. The main technologies involved are Vue's reactive data properties, conditional rendering with v-if, and event handling with methods. By the end, you'll have a functional component that can show and hide notifications based on user interactions.
intro.usecase: Notification systems are essential in modern web applications to keep users informed about important events. You'll see them in e-commerce platforms showing order confirmations, social media apps displaying new messages, and productivity tools alerting about task deadlines. As a Vue developer, you'll implement these notifications in dashboards, admin panels, and user interfaces where real-time feedback is crucial. This pattern helps create professional, user-friendly applications that communicate effectively with users.
